name: Concrete & Paving
tagline: Slabs, driveways, paths, exposed aggregate, paving
extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional concreting and paving company. Ask about the area size, surface type, access, and whether excavation is needed. Ask about reinforcement, finish, and drainage. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on site. Do not promise a specific finish or structural outcome that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: We hold [licence number] and [insurance type and provider]. Certificates are available on request before work starts.
{price_note} Concreting is priced per square metre, including excavation and finishing where it is in scope.
Yes, we do exposed aggregate and coloured concrete. Tell us the finish and colour you want so we can quote the right option.
Yes, we do stamped and stencilled concrete. Tell us your pattern and colour preferences during the site visit.
Yes, we do polished and honed concrete. The finish depends on the slab condition, so we confirm it at the site visit.
Yes, we use mesh and bar reinforcement where the job needs it. Tell us how the slab will be used so we can confirm the reinforcement.

kb.q: How long before I can use it?
kb.a: Foot traffic is usually possible after 24–48 hours, and vehicles usually after about 7 days. Weather and the mix can change this.
Yes, we excavate and prepare the base for your slab. Excavation is priced per cubic metre.
Yes, we break up and remove old concrete. Removal is priced per square metre, and disposal costs are shown on the quote.
Yes, we do paving in concrete, brick, and stone pavers. Tell us the pattern and edge you want.
Yes, we build concrete and block retaining walls. Height and ground conditions affect the design, so we check them at the site visit.
Yes, we do footings for extensions and structures. Footings are priced per cubic metre.
Some driveways and crossovers need council approval. Check with your council before work starts, and we can advise on what applies.
Yes, we allow for drainage and fall in the design. Tell us where water runs off so we can plan the slope.
Yes, we service commercial projects. Commercial work is priced separately and quoted after a site visit.
{warranty_note} Ask us for the warranty period and what it covers before you sign.
We service the local metro area. Ask us to confirm your suburb.

kb.q: Do I need to be home?
kb.a: You do not need to be home for the work, but we do need access to the site. Tell us if you want to be there for the site visit.
Yes, we repair cracks, spalling, and sinking slabs. Tell us how long the damage has been there so we can recommend a repair or replacement.
Yes, we do oxide and coloured concrete. Colour can vary with the mix and weather, so we discuss samples before the pour.

templates.booking_confirmation: Hi {customer}, the site visit for your {job} with {business} is booked for {date}.
templates.quote_intro: Here is the quote for your {job}. It is based on the scope we agreed at the site visit.
templates.invoice_note: Thank you. This invoice follows the progress or completion stage shown above.

automation_rules.description: Remind owner 30 days before insurance expires

compliance.guidance: Check whether a building permit, registration or domestic building insurance applies to the work before you quote. Keep certificates of currency for public liability and any required insurance. Your state regulator sets the rules.
items: Registration or licence number on quotes where required
Permit records kept against the project
